value.name: Asha sets documents beside herself
value.description: Asha places the papers at her own elbow and fixes Daniel with a steady stare.
evidence: set them at her own elbow, and then she lifted her eyes to Daniel and held them there.

value.name: Daniel hesitates and looks away
value.description: Daniel stops fidgeting, exhales sharply, and looks toward the hallway before speaking again.
evidence: He did not move at first; only the small working of his fingers at his cuff stopped, and his breath went out of him in a short, audible push
He looked away from all three of them, toward the dim shape of the hallway

value.name: Daniel asks for the original log
value.description: Daniel abandons his earlier line of questioning and asks where the original log is.
evidence: "Where is the original log?" he asked
he had abandoned the notary and the seal and was reaching now for something further off

value.name: Asha shields the codicil
value.description: Asha pulls the codicil closer to her body, signaling that she is withholding something from Daniel.
evidence: Asha drew the codicil another inch closer, tucking it almost against her ribs

value.name: Asha challenges Daniel's assumption
value.description: Asha quietly asks Daniel why he thinks she did not bring the original log, forcing him to lean in to hear her.
evidence: "Why do you think I didn't bring it?" she asked, soft enough that he had to lean a little to catch it

value.name: Daniel withholds a response
value.description: Daniel does not answer Asha and resumes his nervous cuff-fidgeting.
evidence: He didn't answer; his fingers found his cuff again and stopped there, halfway to a gesture he didn't complete.

value.name: Rosa backs Asha with the journal
value.description: Rosa taps the journal and states that its entries do not lie while keeping her gaze on Daniel.
evidence: From the other side of the table Rosa reached out and tapped the cover of the journal at Asha's elbow, twice
"The entries don't lie," without taking her eyes off Daniel.

value.name: Daniel realizes the log is missing
value.description: Daniel looks at the journal and understands that the logbook he hoped was upstairs is no longer there.
evidence: He looked at the journal then for the first time, and Asha watched him understand that whatever he had been hoping was still upstairs in a logbook had already bee
